name: meridian
description: Completion, hover documentation, diagnostics from the real compiler, navigation, formatting and lint for Meridian documents.

meridian.path.markdownDescription: The `meridian` command to run as the language server. A bare name is looked up on `PATH`; `${workspaceFolder}` stands for the first workspace folder.

meridian.pluginDirs.markdownDescription: Directories to load target plugins (`meridian-target-<name>`) from. They are searched before the directory the `meridian` command is in. `${workspaceFolder}` stands for the first workspace folder.

meridian.lint.enabled.markdownDescription: Show `meridian lint` findings alongside the compiler's errors.

meridian.format.sortFields.markdownDescription: When formatting, write fields in the language's own order. Turn off to keep the order they were written in (`meridian fmt --keep-order`).

meridian.trace.server.description: Log the messages exchanged with the language server to the Meridian output channel.

scripts.package: npm run build -- --minify && vsce package --no-dependencies --out meridian.vsix
scripts.test:e2e: npm run build && tsc -p test/e2e && node out-e2e/run.js
